=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- Requirement: The plan (docs/plans/issue-5899-flag-allowlisted-classifier-denials-plan.md:85) says agents.md should document the allow-rule and permission-mode behavior. CLAUDE.md §7 requires agents.md to be updated when behavior changes. The last commit (0ffd19e) made the single-command check quote-aware via `_shell_visible_text` in the twin, but agents.md (lines 1174-1178) still describes the pre-AD-4 quote-naive check: "a single command (no shell operator, newline, backtick, or `$(`)". After AD-4, operators inside quotes (except backtick/`$(` inside double quotes) no longer block the match, so this description understates when the "Already allowlisted" line appears. The twin's own docstring was updated in the last run to say "outside quotes" but agents.md was not.
  Expected change site: agents.md, the bullet beginning "The issue body and each 'Seen again' comment also show the permission mode" (lines ~1174-1178)
  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF (commit 0ffd19e) modified workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py to add `_shell_visible_text` and made `_matching_allow_rule` quote-aware, and updated the module docstring to say "outside quotes, never matches". agents.md was not touched in that commit. Its bullet still reads "no shell operator, newline, backtick, or `$(`" without the "outside quotes" qualifier that the twin docstring now carries. The test `test_allow_rule_for_ignores_quoted_and_escaped_operators` asserts that `git merge -m 'a|b' origin/x` matches `Bash(git merge *)`, directly contradicting the agents.md description.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
